notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped ordinary attribute update surface across Time Constrained disable and re-enable. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies preservation of queued delivery, reflection metadata, and terminal retraction across the time-role transition without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues with DisableTimeConstrained/EnableTimeConstrained and FederateAmbassador time-role, reflection, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute update/time-role declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
